matches.description: Given a finite-dimensional Lie algebra over GF(p) with structure constants, compute the Chevalley-Eilenberg chain complex with trivial coefficients. The chain groups are C_p = Lambda^p(g) and the differential is built from the Lie bracket structure constants. Structure constants are validated as a genuine Lie bracket (alternating, antisymmetric, Jacobi) at the request boundary.
matches.title: Compute the Chevalley-Eilenberg chain complex for a Lie algebra

matches.description: Given a finite-dimensional Lie algebra over GF(p) with structure constants, compute the exact homology groups H_p(g, K) using the Chevalley-Eilenberg chain complex and Gaussian elimination over GF(p). Structure constants are validated as a genuine Lie bracket (alternating, antisymmetric, Jacobi) at the request boundary.
matches.title: Compute Lie algebra homology with trivial coefficients

matches.description: For bounded homogeneous h in QQ[x_1,...,x_n], supplied sparsely or, for n=3, as labelled linear forms, construct every graded map (QQ[x_1,...,x_n]_q)^n -> QQ[x_1,...,x_n]_(q+deg(h)-1) from q=0 and stop at the first nonzero kernel or the finite degree bound. This operation returns rank certificates only; use the coefficient ledger for sparse map entries.
matches.title: Compute the first graded Jacobian syzygy degree

matches.description: Compute the center {z : z*a = a*z for all a} of a finite-dimensional algebra given by structure constants over a prime field.
matches.title: Compute the center of a finite-dimensional algebra

matches.description: Return the exact rank bound to its direction and map.
matches.title: Compute finite linear-map rank over the prime field
